estimand_and_scale: WLS coefficients (outcome: relative ROA x 100; regressor: strategic deviation in summed absolute z-score units and its square). Null value 0.
justification_primary: The unit of analysis and of the article's own outlier procedure is the bank-year (one bank-year was identified by studentized deleted residuals and removed). Leave-one-row-out therefore probes the same kind of influence the article screened for.
justification_secondary: Bank-years of one bank share a lagged outcome and persistent strategy, so whole-bank deletion shows dependence on a single institution. Reported separately; not shown as the figure's primary range.
scope: Both base configurations O_A and O_B; models M2 and M3; every eligible row or bank, no selection by effect size. Variables, benchmarks and lags are not rebuilt after deletion (pure influence on the fitted regression).
inference_in_figure: Two-sided p from conventional WLS t statistic; the hypothesised directions are H1 positive / H2 negative for M2_SD and negative for M3_SD2. Threshold drawn at 0.05 (the article's least stringent star level). p values below 1e-300 are plotted at 1e-300 and flagged.
status: Influence ranges are diagnostics, not confidence intervals, and do not enter the equivalent-specification set.
